sources.entry: bitmagnet - BitTorrent indexer, DHT crawler, content classifier and torrent search engine with web UI, GraphQL API and Servarr stack integration. (Source Code) MIT Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: bitmagnet is a self-hosted BitTorrent indexer and DHT crawler that classifies discovered torrents and makes them searchable through a web UI and GraphQL API.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only gives a one-paragraph description. It describes bitmagnet as a self-hosted BitTorrent indexer, DHT crawler, content classifier and torrent search engine. It names a web UI, a GraphQL API, and integration with the Servarr stack. The README points to bitmagnet.io for more information. No installation steps, configuration details, or feature lists are included in the README text provided. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under archiving and digital preservation, and gives the language as Go with Docker.
use_cases: searching torrents through a web interface
feeding torrent search into Servarr apps
notable: Crawls the BitTorrent DHT network to discover torrents
Exposes a GraphQL API alongside a web UI
caveats: README is minimal and defers details to the project website
No install or run instructions appear in the README text provided
